tour.title: Project Overview & Entry Point
tour.description: Start with the project README describing JX as a microkernel OS in Java, then inspect the build configuration (Ant + NetBeans), and finally the kernel initialization entry point at src/jx/emulation/Init.java where the system boots.

tour.title: Kernel Core — Buffers, Domains, Timers & Concurrency
tour.description: Explore the microkernel core: buffer list management for I/O, domain abstraction for process isolation, the timer subsystem for scheduling, XDR encoding for inter-domain communication, and concurrency primitives (locks, monitors, condition variables).

tour.title: Classfile System — Loading Java Classes
tour.description: The classfile subsystem parses Java .class files into runtime representations. ClassData is the central entry point; it delegates to MethodData, FieldData, CodeData, and the constant pool (ConstantPoolData) for resolving symbolic references.

tour.title: File System — EXT2 & Block Buffer Cache
tour.description: The filesystem layer implements EXT2 with permission checks and a block buffer cache. FilesystemImpl coordinates reads/writes; BufferHead and BufferFreeList manage cached disk blocks; RegularFileImpl and ReadOnlyRegularFileImpl serve file I/O requests.

tour.title: Networking Stack — TCP/IP Protocol Suite
tour.description: The networking stack implements a layered protocol model: Ethernet frames, ARP for address resolution, IP routing, and TCP for reliable connections. Dispatch.java handles demultiplexing incoming packets across protocol layers.

tour.title: Device Drivers — PCI & USB
tour.description: Device drivers span PCI enumeration (PCIDeviceImpl), a 3Com 3C905 NIC driver (metaxa package), and a USB UHCI host-controller framework (JNode). Befehl.java provides low-level port I/O for the NIC; UHCIIO handles USB scheduling.

tour.title: Security Framework & Java Standard Library
tour.description: The security framework provides crypto providers (JCE Cipher, KeyStore), permissions, and the Security manager. The Java standard library reimplements java.io, java.lang, java.net, and java.util atop the JX kernel, including file I/O (File, FilePermission) and character encoding (EncodingManager).
